hypothesis.name: Kneser K(n,k), likely n=16, k=4 (to be confirmed by binomial_match)
evidence: spectrum_integral = true with 5 distinct eigenvalues 495, 45, 1, -9, -165 (alternating-sign pattern of a Kneser graph with k = 4 gives k+1 = 5 eigenvalues)

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 455 for this 1820-receiver graph. The lower bound comes from an independent set of size 455 (check passed). The upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_2 whose length meets 455; the code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed. It took 1 code and 1 critic round. On accuracy the agent tied kushagra_agent (exact 455) and did better than the CP-SAT baselines: cpsat_alpha reached 455 but unproven, cpsat_cover found nothing, frac_cover gave 1800, and f2_minrank_sat only reached a lower bound of 454. On time it lost clearly. wall_s was 95.465 (compute_s 74.01, llm_s 21.455), against 1.90 s for kushagra_agent. Most of the compute time went to the 71 s describe step. Nothing looks suspicious.
